description:
Pre-payment counterparty check: before paying, approving or interacting with an EVM (Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum One) or Solana address, get ok / caution / block. Free preview tier: verdict, confidence, address kind and flag counts. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005), /v1/quick ($0.015) and /v1/full ($0.05) add the reasons and evidence (OFAC SDN, scam lists, x402 directory, verification, deployer, names, cross-chain, age, exposure). Informational safety check, not legal or financial advice.

[CounterpartyCheck via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as CounterpartyCheck's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 / quick $0.015 / full $0.05 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

address.description: Counterparty address: EVM 0x + 40 hex, or a Solana base58 address

chain.description: Chain of the payment (default base; a base58 address implies solana)

intent.description: What you are about to do (default pay): changes which signals matter, e.g. paying a token contract or approving an EOA

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.005, quick $0.015, full $0.05. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
